title: HTTP client has no timeout
body:
## Problem

`http.Client{}` waits forever on a stalled server.

## Evidence

`client := &http.Client{}`

## Impact

One slow upstream hangs the worker.

## Fix

Set `Timeout: 10 * time.Second`.

## Resolution (2026-10-03)

Timeout added.

title: Dependency with a known vulnerability
body:
## Problem

The pinned module has a published advisory.

## Evidence

`govulncheck` reports it as reachable.

## Impact

Crafted input crashes the parser.

## Fix

Upgrade to the fixed release.

title: Action pinned by tag
body:
## Problem

The checkout action looked tag-pinned.

## Evidence

It is pinned by commit SHA with the tag as a comment.

## Impact

None.

## Fix

None needed.

## Resolution (2026-09-21)

Invalid: the action is SHA-pinned.
